<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Rebound:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty opened higher, reclaiming the 24,000 level, driven by a rally in banking stocks and substantial forex inflows totaling $127 billion.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Liquidity Surplus:</strong> India&#x27;s banking system liquidity has surged to a 4.5-year high of Rs 7.76 lakh crore, providing a supportive environment for domestic financial assets.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
